d: The Samajwadi Party and Congress are heading into a fresh political tussle over seat-sharing ahead of the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections. Akhilesh Yadav’s 'Special 26' formula, the SP’s announcement of five candidates before finalising the alliance, and Congress leader Imran Masood’s public criticism have exposed growing differences between the two parties. From the Saharanpur seats to Amethi and Rae Bareli, disagreements over seat allocation and winning prospects threaten opposition unity. Why is Akhilesh putting pressure on Congress? What does Congress want?
